File: docs/18-admin-console.md.

Principle: managed versioned-resource editor; every change = draft
-> validation -> impact -> approval -> publish -> audit; high-risk
-> MFA/step-up.

Schema catalog: packages/types/predicates/revisions/deps/usage;
draft from published, add/inherit type, add predicate, cardinality/
domain/range/temporal, identity/normalization, index/search,
classification, translations, views, validate/impact/publish/
retire. Stable IDs immutable; confusable check.

Form/View designer: sections/tabs/columns, field components, safe-
DSL visibility, list filters/sorts, relation groups, capabilities,
responsive/persona/locale/RTL previews, a11y warnings; never
unhides policy-hidden field.

Migration center: source/target, steps, preview, affected rows,
invalid/collisions, estimates, dry run, approval, progress,
quarantine, verification, cutover/compensation. Blocked on unmapped
security rule or required issue.

Users: identity status, both group classes separately, intervals,
MFA/session/device, revoke, service accounts, review, impersonation/
delegation audit. Secrets never shown.

Capability groups: function/action matrix, default deny, acyclic,
effective preview w/ origin rules, no data selectors.

Data groups: target tenant/type/entity/predicate/relation/
classification; actions read/create/edit/retire/traverse/export/
history; conditions, fields/masks, validity/purpose, allow/deny,
owner/legal basis. Simulation: persona + example -> obligations +
impact + side-channel warnings; no raw SQL.

Four-eyes: author submits -> independent approver -> step-up ->
publish -> audit; no self-approval; emergency = break-glass.

Connectors: catalog/instance, ops, endpoint/proxy, secret presence/
rotate (write-only), license/purpose, quota, mapping version,
redacted health, test, enable/disable, retention, monitors.

Editors: criteria builder (typed expression, inputs, severity/
weight, explanation, evidence, tests, synthetic preview); workflow
(states/transitions, tasks, SLA/calendar, conditions, actions,
escalation, compensation) + linter (unreachable, no terminal,
unguarded loops, missing perms).

Reports: definitions/templates, params, dataset AST, formats,
classification, schedule, recipients, limits; synthetic/authorized
preview.

Translations: key x locale matrix, completeness/fallback, ICU
plural preview, overflow, RTL preview, bundle import/export,
draft/review/publish.

Jobs/projections: queues/lag/dead letters, retry/cancel,
generations/checksums; rebuild = capability/reason + new gen;
watermark not hand-edited.

Audit explorer: actor/action/resource/time/decision filters; safe
diff, revisions, actors, reason, integrity; export = separate
right.

Settings: locale/tz/retention, brand, limits, origins, OIDC refs,
calendars, feature flags, maintenance windows; DB URL/secrets not
editable.

Protection: env banner, destructive confirm w/ name/reason, impact/
dry run, optimistic concurrency, undo via new revision, estimate
before bulk, time-limited grants, stable-ID diffs, orphan-ref
prevention, observable publish locks.

Acceptance: schema built+published via UI; rename keeps ID/data;
collisions surfaced; person-deny simulation; both group classes;
secret unreadable; RTL preview; second approver; audit links
draft->approvals->publish.

fields.kb_summary: Threat model: asset inventory, trust boundaries, STRIDE threats with countermeasures, specific attacks (SQLi, IDOR, mass assignment, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, file attacks, formula injection, graph inference, cache/log leaks, supply chain), encryption policy, data lifecycle, the security test gate list, and incident readiness.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/20-threat-model.md.

Assets: PII/ID docs, ЮЛ data/contracts/limits/debt/collateral,
relation graph, risk criteria/decisions, accounts/tokens/secrets,
connector licenses/payloads, reports, schemas/policies, audit,
availability.

Boundaries: browser <-> Nuxt/proxy <-> Rocket API <-> PDP <-> PG/
storage <-> worker <-> external sources — each authenticates/
authorizes/validates/limits/audits.

STRIDE: Spoofing -> OIDC PKCE/state/nonce, MFA, secure cookie,
refresh rotation+reuse detection, mTLS, Argon2id, revocation.
Tampering -> parameterized sqlx, stable IDs, four-eyes, signed
bundles/hashes, immutable revisions, outbox/inbox, checksums,
tamper-evident audit. Repudiation -> original/effective actor,
decision IDs, reason, immutable events. Disclosure -> PEP rewrite
before SQL, RLS, allowlist, aggregate policy, tenant/policy cache
keys, redaction, classified search, encryption, short downloads.
DoS -> limits, cost guard, bounded queues, statement_timeout,
keyset, async jobs, scanning, quotas/breakers, backpressure.
Elevation -> default deny/deny-overrides, two classes, scoped
service identity, step-up/four-eyes, break-glass, simulation,
negative tests.

Specific: SQLi (no interpolation; catalog identifiers); IDOR (UUID
grants nothing; hidden -> 404); mass assignment (deny unknown
fields; system fields never from body); XSS (escaping, sanitizer,
CSP, sandbox); CSRF/CORS (token + SameSite + Origin allowlist);
SSRF (endpoint allowlist, DNS/IP validation, egress proxy,
redirect revalidation, blocked private ranges); files (signature
over extension, zip limits, macro detection, AV, isolated
converter); formula injection (escaping, allowlist, no execution);
graph inference (denied excluded each step; counts/facets/paths
authorized); cache leak (tenant/shape/locale/revision keys); log
leak (allowlist; no secrets/PII); supply chain (lockfile, audits,
signatures, SBOM, reproducible, secret scanning).

Encryption: TLS 1.2+; encrypted volumes; envelope for secrets;
per-tenant/purpose key IDs; KMS rotation; keyed identity hashes;
encrypted backups; never in repo/logs. Never replaces access
control.

Lifecycle: classification -> retention/archive/legal hold/export/
deletion; GDPR via jurisdiction; erasure vs hold documented;
crypto-shredding after dependency plan.

Gates: authz matrix; cross-tenant properties; hidden field/filter/
sort/facet/graph/report/export; deny conflicts; RLS pool leak;
CSRF/CORS/IDOR; SQL/AST fuzz; upload/zip/formula; SSRF; dependency/
container scan; secrets scan; pentest pre-prod. Confirmed leak =
release blocker.

Incident: detect -> revoke -> disable -> preserve evidence ->
assess -> notify -> patch -> rotate -> verify -> postmortem.

fields.kb_summary: Observability and operations: structured JSON logs with a strict allowlist, RED/USE metrics with bounded label cardinality, W3C traces, audit-vs-logs separation, health endpoints, SLO/error budget, the actionable alert list, dashboards, backup and disaster-recovery runbook with RPO/RTO goals, graceful shutdown, required runbooks, capacity forecasting, and JIT operational access.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/21-observability-and-operations.md.

Logs (structured JSON): timestamp/level/service/version/env,
request/correlation/trace, hashed tenant, route/action/outcome/
status, duration/error ID, plan fingerprint, job/event/connector
IDs. Forbidden: tokens/secrets, raw req/res, SQL values, PII,
connector payload; debug via redaction allowlist.

Metrics: RED (API) + USE (DB/worker) — DbExecutor queue/pool/
saturation, SQL fingerprints, outbox lag/dead-letters, job queue/
leases/heartbeat, projection watermark/lag, connector latency/
quota/circuit, PDP latency/cache/deny, auth anomalies, report
rows/bytes, PG connections/WAL/replica/vacuum/bloat, storage
errors. Bounded label cardinality.

Traces: W3C context through Rocket -> PEP -> DbExecutor -> worker/
connector; no payloads; jobs via causation links.

Audit != logs: audit = evidence w/ retention/integrity + separate
access; logs = diagnostics w/ short TTL.

Health: /health/live (no external calls); /health/ready (config,
DB, PDP/policy, storage/queue, migrations); /health/startup;
detailed internal; public generic. Connector failure = degraded;
authz failure -> unready/fail closed.

SLO/budget: separate SLI per surface; maintenance per policy;
budget steers rollout.

Alerts (owner/severity/runbook/test): RLS canary (critical), auth
spike/reuse, PDP down/indeterminate, DB saturation/replica/WAL,
outbox/projection lag, stuck leases, connector auth/quota, backup
failure/age, audit chain failure, cert expiry, capacity.

Dashboards: executive SLO, API/DB perf, security/PDP, jobs/
projections, connectors, reports, PG maintenance, tenant fairness.

Backup: WAL + base backups, storage versioning/replication,
bundles/config refs, KMS backup, encrypted + geo-compliant,
automated restore validation, documented RPO/RTO — exists only
after a restore drill.

DR: declare/freeze -> restore -> verify migrations/audit ->
reconcile outbox/inbox/jobs -> rebuild projections -> canaries ->
reopen read then write -> document gap. Initial RPO <=15min,
RTO <=4h.

Shutdown: drop readiness, reject long work, drain HTTP, cancel/
wait DB jobs, flush telemetry; worker releases leases, saves
cursor; outbox retryable.

Runbooks: DB down/saturated, plan regression, RLS/policy issue,
leaked credential, connector outage/drift, projection rebuild,
stuck/dead-letter job, failed migration, disk/WAL growth, backup
restore, rollback, data leak, key rotation.

Capacity: monthly forecast + planned-scaling thresholds.

Ops access: JIT/time-limited, MFA, bastion, least privilege,
approval/audit; DBA != app user; raw query = ticket + masked
replica.

fields.kb_summary: Testing and quality: the 10-level pyramid, domain property tests, real-PostgreSQL persistence tests, the security persona matrix, API contract tests, query tests, connector fixtures, import/report tests, Nuxt tests, performance scenario manifests and soak, chaos/failure invariants, static/supply checks, synthetic-data rules, and DoD coverage.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/22-testing-and-quality.md.

Pyramid: domain unit/property -> crate contract -> PG repository/
integration -> security negative/info-flow -> API/OpenAPI ->
connector fixtures -> Nuxt component/E2E/a11y -> migration/
upgrade/rollback -> perf/soak/failure -> pentest/DR.

Domain properties: normalization idempotent; canonical
deterministic; fingerprint; symmetric edge order; cardinality
under concurrency; merge/split acyclic; migration round-trip/
residual; decimal/time deterministic; same inputs -> same risk;
workflow invariants.

Persistence (real PG only): fresh + per-release upgrade;
constraints; identity/fingerprint races; optimistic locking;
rollback/outbox atomicity; SKIP LOCKED; RLS context; pooled
reset; partition pruning; plan snapshots; tz/Unicode/decimal;
serialization retry.

Security matrix (personas x actions x resources x fields x
relations x purposes): default deny; deny-overrides; two classes;
object/type/field/edge; GET/list/search/filter/sort/facet/count/
graph/history/blob; report/export/import error file; WS/event;
cache; worker/service account; impersonation/break-glass; policy
change mid-session. Negative tests check rows + DOM/network/
artifact/log/cache.

API contracts: OpenAPI snapshot/compat; strict DTO; statuses/
codes; ETag/If-Match; idempotency commit-before-response; cursor
tamper; limits/malformed; CSRF/CORS; cancellation; WS
reauthorization; consumer-driven tests.

Query: AST fuzz; operator typing; bind/no literals; security
filter in every subquery/step; cost guard; keyset completeness;
null/collation; cycles; aggregate inference; fingerprint
equivalence; injection strings.

Connectors: synthetic fixtures, sandbox smoke, drift, pagination,
rate/quota, retry/timeout, ambiguous, malformed, duplicates,
mapping version, legal flags, redaction, secret rotation.

Import/report: both supplied XLSX; multi-row founders; date/
decimal/Unicode; dedupe/retry; formula/macro/external-link; zip/
MIME; error coordinates; 100k/1M streaming memory; DOCX/XLSX/PDF
golden; hidden fields absent; locale/RTL/fonts.

Nuxt: renderer per kind; permission removes DOM/actions; personas;
412 conflict/draft; policy event clears state; virtual list;
graph cycle/hidden node; jobs/reconnect; keyboard/focus/zoom/RTL/
axe; CSP/XSS; visual regression.

Performance: scenario manifest (SHA, schema, seed/size, config/
hardware, concurrency, warmup/duration, SLO); profiles incl.
lookup, card, list, FTS, graph, writes, import/export, policy
cold/cache, catch-up. Soak 8-24h. Gates per kb.docs.11.

Chaos: kill per job phase; DB restart/failover; replica lag;
storage down; PDP/cache down; connector timeout; outbox dup/
reorder; clock skew; disk pressure; lost post-commit response.
Invariants: no duplicate, no unauthorized fallback, resumable,
explicit status.

Static/supply: fmt/clippy; test/nextest; deny/audit; vue-tsc/
eslint; npm audit/SCA; secret scan; SBOM; container scan/sign;
migration lint; OpenAPI breaking check.

Test data: synthetic; no prod dump w/o anonymization; versioned
classified fixtures; no real IDs.

DoD: coverage % != risk; critical code needs branch/property +
mutation where feasible; done = link + tests + telemetry +
migration/rollback + docs + security/perf review.

fields.kb_summary: Deployment and configuration: supported topologies (on-prem single site, HA multi-zone, dedicated tenant shard), container image rules, environment list, typed TOML config with secret refs, secret manager coverage, TLS/network policy, the CI/CD stage order, expand/contract DB deploy, rollout order, Nuxt asset delivery, readiness order, scaling rules, and the production checklist.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/23-deployment-and-configuration.md.

Topologies: on-prem single site (LB -> api x N -> PG primary/
replica -> storage -> workers); HA multi-zone; dedicated tenant
shard (same release).

Containers: minimal non-root, pinned digest, read-only FS,
bounded tmp, no shell/pkg mgr, seccomp/cap drop, health endpoints,
SBOM/signature, UTC + needed locale/fonts, controlled CA trust.

Environments: local/test/staging/production; prod data/secrets
never copied down; own OIDC/DB/storage/keys/domains/connectors;
env banner outside prod.

Typed TOML: [http] public_origin/request_timeout_ms/max_json_bytes;
[database] url_secret_ref/max_connections/acquire_timeout_ms/
statement_timeout_ms/db_executor_queue; [security]
policy_cache_ttl_seconds/fail_closed/internal_mtls_identity;
[storage] backend/bucket/encryption_key_ref; [jobs] lease_seconds/
max_attempts. No passwords in files; prefixed env overrides;
unknown prod setting = startup error.

Secrets (KMS): DB cred, OIDC secret, token signing/encryption keys,
connector creds, storage keys, identity-hash keys, SMTP/webhook;
short-lived where possible; rotation overlap; never logged.

TLS/network: HTTPS/mTLS trusted-proxy contract; forwarded headers
only known proxies; DB TLS; policies browser->public, API->DB/PDP/
storage, worker->DB/storage/egress; egress allowlist; cert
monitor.

CI/CD: lint/unit -> integration PG/security -> API/UI contract ->
SCA/secret/SBOM/container -> migration fresh/upgrade -> E2E/a11y
-> perf smoke -> signed artifacts -> staging -> canary -> approval
-> prod rolling/canary -> post-deploy checks.

DB deploy: expand first; sqlx migrate as separate job + advisory
lock + owner role; resumable backfill; contract after drain;
CONCURRENTLY/partition per runbook.

Rollout: compatible app first; flags off; canary; monitor;
gradual; rollback binary while compatible; irreversible ->
compensation.

Nuxt: hashed immutable assets; index no-cache; same-origin API;
public config = origin/build/version; private source maps; CSP/SRI.

Readiness: secrets/config -> DB TLS -> migration compat -> policy/
schema -> storage/deps -> workers/routes -> ready. Worker never
runs unsupported schema/event version.

Scaling: HPA on CPU + queue metrics within global connection
budget; worker per queue class; no scale-to-zero for latency-
critical API/PDP; tenant fairness quotas.

Prod checklist: no default passwords; migrations verified; RLS
FORCE + grants; OIDC/MFA/CSRF/CORS/CSP; keys/certs/rotation;
restore drill; audit chain; limits; alerts/runbooks; connector
legal/quotas; locale/fonts; load/pentest; rollback/compensation.

fields.kb_summary: Migration off the legacy Rocket 0.5-rc prototype: the catalogued limitations, the strangler transition rule, stages 0-7 (repo security, workspace skeleton, security baseline, meta-kernel, data extraction, SKR package, Nuxt, dual-run), the type-mapping table, reconciliation requirements, API compatibility, the reuse/never-reuse lists, and migration acceptance.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/24-current-code-migration.md.

Prototype (legacy-prototype/, excluded): Rocket 0.5-rc, Object/
ObjectType/Field, Link/LinkType, Dictionary, User/Group/Permission,
sqlx/PG, LFU cache — PoC, not baseline.

Limitations: stale deps; plaintext DB password; format-string SQL;
lazy-static pool + block_on; String IDs; RawHtml/generic ERROR; 500
on client validation; allow-by-absence permissions; post-
materialization field security; non-universal ФЛ/ЮЛ; definition/
value mixed; no statement invariant; dynamic DDL; unproven cache;
secrets in domain types; RISE DDL; no Nuxt/jobs/outbox/policy/
provenance/observability.

Rule: never rewrite in place — new workspace alongside, strangler +
importer; old sources stay reference.

Stage 0 repo security: rotate DB password; remove tracked secrets
-> ref/env; ban prototype for prod data; scanning; read-only
snapshot. History keeps secrets — rotation mandatory.

Stage 1 skeleton: apps/crates per docs/05; Rocket health, typed
config/error/context, DbExecutor, sqlx migrations; legacy routes
not auto-connected.

Stage 2 security baseline: tenant/principal/session, capability +
data groups, PDP/PEP, RLS, audit — before any data API; legacy
permissions -> draft policies + simulation.

Stage 3 meta-kernel/graph: meta/core tables, domain types,
statement families, identity/idempotency/outbox; schema publish +
basic CRUD. Mapping: ObjectType->TypeDefinition; Field->
PredicateDefinition; Object.filled.fields->Entity+scalar
statements; Link->edge/reified relation; Dictionary->classifier.

Stage 4 extraction: read-only parameterized extractor; immutable
source records; normalized IDs/values; mapped domain; row-level
quarantine; old-ID aliases; count/relation/hash reconciliation.
Idempotent by source fingerprint + table + PK + mapping version.

Stage 5 SKR package: bundle ФЛ/ЮЛ/holding/contact/document/address/
request/check/risk/collateral + views/identity/workflow/
translations/Excel mapping; no structs in core.

Stage 6 Nuxt: login/layout, dynamic list/card/form/relations/tree,
checks/reports/jobs, admin; legacy read-only meanwhile.

Stage 7 dual-run: new writes to new canon; legacy one-way
projection only; UAT; freeze legacy; delta import; switch; archive;
decommission.

Reconciliation per table/type: source/imported/quarantined/skipped,
merges/candidates, statements by predicate, orphan links, tz,
null/empty, dup keys, checksum buckets, sampled compare; cutover
blocked on delta.

API compat: separate adapter (old paths -> new commands + security
decision + deprecation deadline); RawHtml/generic ERROR never
carried.

Reusable: domain knowledge/scenarios, Rocket organization, type/
field/link/dictionary concepts, auth reference, fixtures + SQL
model, Cargo.lock. Never reused: SQL string builders, secret
config, allow-by-absence, dynamic DDL.

Acceptance: rows accounted; old ID resolves; links/provenance/
history kept; no dup identity; permissions not widened; secrets
rotated; scenario equivalence; SLOs; rollback rehearsed;
decommission approved.

fields.kb_summary: Delivery plan and acceptance: the seven vertical phases with exit criteria, connector priority order, Definition of Done, the eleven end-to-end acceptance scenarios (A-K), performance/security/documentation acceptance, and the explicit non-criteria for readiness.
fields.kb_content:
File: docs/25-delivery-plan-and-acceptance.md.

Phases + exits:
- P0 Foundation: workspace, CI, config/secrets, Rocket health/
  error/context, DbExecutor, migrations, observability, dev stack.
  Exit: safe app connects; backup smoke; no secrets; SCA.
- P1 Security/meta-kernel: tenant/identity/session, two group
  classes, PDP/PEP/RLS/audit, draft/publish. Exit: default-deny
  matrix; schema publishes; leak tests pass.
- P2 Entity graph: statements, identity/idempotency, CRUD/history,
  AST/keyset, relations/graph, projections/search. Exit: arbitrary
  type without code; dedupe; 100M SLO.
- P3 Nuxt core/admin: auth/layout, dynamic UI, jobs, admin, i18n/
  a11y. Exit: new type live without deploy; role UI/E2E/RTL pass.
- P4 SKR package: ФЛ/ЮЛ/holding, request/check/risk/workflow, Excel
  import, views. Exit: DOCX/XLSX scenarios; no hardcoded objects.
- P5 Connectors/monitoring: SDK, sources, provenance, schedules,
  criteria/reactions. Exit: sandbox checks, idempotent monitoring,
  legal/quota controls.
- P6 Reporting/production: reports/exports, perf, HA/DR, pentest,
  cutover. Exit: checklist, restore/rollback drill, signed release,
  UAT.

Connector order: internal DB -> supplied imports -> authoritative
tax/company -> enforcement/court/procurement/registration/health
-> Internet/social last.

DoD: requirement link; designs; security classification/policy;
migrations/rollback; tests incl. negative; telemetry; i18n/a11y;
perf/limits; runbook; docs; clean deps; review.

E2E scenarios:
A universal "Склад" package published live, CRUD/search/report.
B 100 concurrent same-phone creates -> one entity; retries one
  ID; distinct extension per policy.
C both ЮЛ workbooks preview/dry-run; graph mapping; repeat import
  no dupes; relations w/ provenance.
D type split/reify/rename round-trip + residual + quarantine +
  concurrent writes in target projection.
E holdings-allowed/person-denied sees zero person data incl.
  counts/graph/report/WS/cache; DB instrumentation confirms.
F field security — one sees passport/phone, other nothing incl.
  sort/facet/export; mass-assign denied.
G check: source timeout != clean; provenance; idempotent factor/
  assessment/task/decision/report/monitor.
H monitor: DST run once; repeat result no dup; real change ->
  evidence/task.
I 100M/500M SLOs; no OFFSET/seq scan.
J i18n names/IDN/decimal/case/DST/RTL/emoji round-trip.
K audit/DR: tamper-evident links; RPO/RTO restore; rebuild;
  canaries.

Perf acceptance: P95 targets; zero unauthorized rows; bounded
graph/export; lag target; no queue collapse; soak stable.

Security acceptance: threat model reviewed; pentest; critical/high
fixed; RLS/PEP matrix; MFA/four-eyes/break-glass; rotation; scans;
drills; connector legal basis.

Docs acceptance: links exist; terms consistent; examples match
contracts; traced; ADR updated.

NOT readiness: small test only, UI-hidden button, SELECT-before-
INSERT, generic JSONB, post-filter permissions, manual SQL,
untested backup, field-policy-free report, plaintext secret,
missing perf dataset.

fields.kb_title: Code map: schema, node kinds, edges, example queries
fields.kb_summary: How the machine-queryable code map is shaped: cm_node kinds, cm_* edges, and ready-made MCP queries to answer "which route/table/tool/crate" questions.
fields.kb_content:
EngineR code map: one cm_node entity per meaningful code element, linked by cm_* edges. Published as schema revision 2 (base 1).

cm_node fields: cm_id (identity, e.g. "crate.domain", "route.post.api.v1.entities", "tool.entities.query", "table.core.statement"), cm_kind, cm_name, cm_path (file path or URL), cm_method, cm_capability (PEP gate), cm_summary, cm_detail, cm_sort, cm_tags.

Kinds: repo | app | crate | package | module | route | tool | table | migration | page | component | composable | middleware | test | config | doc.

Edge predicates (cm_node->cm_node unless noted):
- cm_contains  hierarchy (repo->app/crate/pkg/migration/test; app->module; pkg->page/component)
- cm_depends   build deps (app->crate, crate->crate from Cargo.toml, pkg.nuxt-ui->pkg.web-client)
- cm_exposes   module->API route it implements
- cm_maps_to   MCP tool->API route it forwards to
- cm_calls     UI page/component/composable/web-endpoint->API route
- cm_uses      UI composition (page->component, component->component, composable->useApi)
- cm_persists  route/module->DB table touched
- cm_defines   migration->table it creates
- cm_tests     test->subject it covers
- cm_implements cm_node->kb_article (links code to spec digest kb.docs.NN)

Example queries (all via MCP tools/call):
1. "Which route handles POST /entities?"
   entities.query {query:{from:{type_id:"cm_node"},where:{field:"cm_id",op:"eq",value:"route.post.api.v1.entities"}}}
   or entities.query where cm_path eq "/api/v1/entities" + cm_method eq "POST" (two filters via page/filter keys are not ANDed - filter client-side or use cm_id).
2. "Which MCP tool wraps it?" relations.list {id:<route_pid>, direction:"incoming"} -> cm_maps_to edge -> tool.entities.create.
3. "Which tables does POST /entities write?" relations.list route -> outgoing cm_persists -> core.entity/core.statement/core.identity_key/ops.outbox.
4. "What does the entity page call?" relations.list page.entities.id -> cm_calls outgoing + cm_uses components.
5. "Which routes need capability schema.publish?" entities.query {query:{from:{type_id:"cm_node"},where:{field:"cm_capability",op:"eq",value:"schema.publish"}}}.
6. "What depends on enginer-domain?" relations.list crate.domain direction=incoming -> cm_depends.
7. "Neighborhood map:" entities.graph {id:<app.api pid>, direction:"both", max_depth:2}.
8. "Which spec does crate X implement?" relations.list crate.X -> cm_implements -> kb.docs.NN articles.
Filter ops on query AST: field+op+value where op in eq|prefix|contains; page {size,after}. entities.list cm_node limit<=200.'

fields.cm_summary: Rust workspace (3 apps + 22 crates) + Nuxt 4 admin SPA + typed TS client + sqlx migrations + normative docs/. Root of the code map.
fields.cm_detail: Workspace members per Cargo.toml: apps/{api,worker,mcp} + 22 crates/*. legacy-prototype/ excluded. Postgres schemas core/meta/sec/ops/audit/integration/report. AGPL-3.0, rust-toolchain 1.95-ish.

fields.cm_summary: Rocket 0.5 HTTP JSON API on :8010 — the only public surface; all PDP/PEP enforcement happens here. Mounts /health, /api/v1, /internal/security/v1.
fields.cm_detail: rocket_build (lib.rs): CorsFairing + AuditFairing (tamper-evident audit.event http_request rows for mutations + entity views), uniform catchers, CapabilityGuard PEP on every domain route. main.rs: observability init, ApiConfig, AsyncStdDbExecutor spawn, ENGINER_SEED_DEMO demo seed, local in-process SecurityClient (ADR-008) backed by the PG snapshot provider.

fields.cm_summary: MCP Streamable-HTTP server on :8020 — thin authenticated bridge exposing the HTTP API as ~95 JSON-RPC tools (protocol 2025-06-18).
fields.cm_detail: Bearer egr_* token validated via GET /me/context (30s cache); tools/list filtered by token capabilities; tools/call → prepare_call (path/query/body/if_match/data_base64, path-safety check) → reqwest forward with the same token — authoritative PDP stays API-side. All writes go through tools/call only.

fields.cm_summary: Background worker: ops.outbox drain loop + monitor scheduler (docs/02 §7, ADR-014). No HTTP port.
fields.cm_detail: Tokio loop every 2s: enqueue due integration.monitor runs → claim up to 10 ops.outbox rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED → per-event tenant RLS context → dispatch: check.execute → complete core.check_instance with worker evidence; monitor.run → advance integration.monitor schedule; unknown types logged+marked. Mark dispatched_at, attempts++.

fields.cm_detail: ApiClient: timeout via AbortController, X-Locale/X-Timezone/X-Request-Id, CSRF + If-Match + Idempotency-Key headers, 401 refresh singleflight, typed ApiClientError. 13 endpoint classes + types/ mirror of envelope/error/entity/query/schema/security/skr/view. ~68 Vitest tests.

fields.cm_summary: Production admin UI served by enginer-web:3000; Vue 3 + Nuxt UI 4 + Pinia + vue-i18n (8 locales, ar/he RTL).
fields.cm_detail: SPA; apiBaseUrl=/api/v1 same-origin (nitro routeRules proxy → ENGINER_API_URL). Auth: session cookie + /me/context Pinia store, route middleware, capability UX guards. Metadata-driven UI: views from /schemas/types/{id}/view drive forms/lists.

fields.cm_summary: Signed JSON schema bundle: 15 domain types, ~60 predicates, 7 identity policies, 9 views, 4 workflows, Excel mapping profile, ru/en i18n.
fields.cm_detail: person, legal_entity, holding_view, address, contact_point, document, license, request, check, risk_factor, assessment, decision, task, contract, collateral. Loaded via crates/schema-registry/src/bundle.rs → SchemaDraft → validate → publish. 9 structural Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: postgres:6543, api:8010, mcp:8020, web:3000, worker (no port). ENGINER_SEED_DEMO=true, ENGINER_DEMO_PASSWORD=enginer-demo.

8 locales ru/en/ar(RTL)/he(RTL)/fr/de/es/zh + schema.ts key registry; parity asserted by Vitest.

fields.cm_summary: Pure domain types, newtype ids and invariants (docs/03, 04). No Rocket/sqlx/Nuxt deps — serde/uuid/chrono/blake2 only.
fields.cm_detail: Entity aggregate: monotonic revision, no self-merge, retired rejects mutations except restore, merge→entity_alias+canonical_entity_id. Statement = subject-predicate-object unitary atom (edge or canonical scalar — exactly one). CanonicalScalar 14 kinds. IdentityPolicy/IdentityKey/compute_identity_key (collision: reject|return_existing|create_candidate). Newtype ids (TenantId/EntityId/PublicEntityId/TypeId/PredicateId/StatementId/...). EntityClass Data|Schema|Policy|Workflow|System. fact_fingerprint BLAKE2; ProvenanceRef/SourceRef; ValidPeriod/RecordedTime; TypeDefinition/PredicateDefinition/SchemaRevision meta-kernel types.

fields.cm_summary: Stable HTTP DTOs: ApiEnvelope/ApiMeta/ApiLinks, ApiError+ApiErrorCode wire codes (docs/06); Excel import pipeline (docs/15).
fields.cm_detail: import.rs: MappingProfile/ColumnMapping/CellParser (15 cell kinds: text/date/money/phone/email/integer/decimal/boolean/inn/ogrn/kpp/okved/opf/person_name), ConflictAction, EmptySemantics, ParsedRow/Cell, DryRunRowResult/Summary, PlannedStatement, RowOutcome; parse_cell normalizers (INN 10/12, OGRN 13/15, KPP 9, E.164 RU, DD.MM.YYYY→ISO). 23 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Application layer: use cases + ports + request context (docs/02 §3, docs/05 §5).
fields.cm_detail: Ports (BoxFuture, object-safe): EntityRepository, StatementRepository, IdentityKeyRepository, IdentityPolicyRepository, SchemaRepository, Outbox, AuditSink, Clock, IdGenerator. use_cases: CreateEntity (resolve identity policies → compute keys → insert; unique-conflict → deduplicated — SELECT-before-INSERT forbidden), RetireEntity, MergeEntity. RequestContext/AuthStrength; ApplicationError; test_mocks.

fields.cm_summary: AsyncStdDbExecutor: async-std-owned PgPool bridged to Tokio/Rocket via bounded flume channel + oneshot (docs/02 §6, ADR-007).
fields.cm_detail: Invariants: pool created/closed in async-std runtime; bounded queue + cancellation; tx closure never leaves the runtime (owned results); job panic isolated; graceful shutdown joins; readiness false when DB down or queue saturated. Deadline, DbExecutorConfig, DbError.

fields.cm_summary: PostgreSQL persistence adapter (docs/10): repositories + RLS context. sqlx parameterized only; no dynamic DDL (ADR-006).
fields.cm_detail: RlsContext.install_tx/install_conn/reset_conn — set_config app.tenant_id/principal_id/purpose/policy_revision; tx-local by default. PgEntityRepository, PgStatementRepository, PgIdentityKeyRepository, PgIdentityPolicyRepository, PgSchemaRepository, PgSecuritySnapshotProvider (PDP snapshot: memberships+policy rules).

fields.cm_summary: Security domain model: principals, capabilities, data scopes, decisions (docs/08, 09).
fields.cm_detail: Capability/CapabilityAction wire strings; SecurityDecision + DecisionEffect + Obligations (QueryObligations/DataObligations/MutationObligations) + FieldMask/FieldPolicy/MandatoryFilter; PolicyRule/PolicyRuleEffect/ResourceSelector; Principal/GroupClass (capability|data)/PrincipalGroupMembership.

fields.cm_summary: Policy Decision Point — pure evaluation engine (docs/08 §4, docs/09). Default deny (ADR-011), fail closed.
fields.cm_detail: PdpEngine::evaluate(snapshot, request): 1 verify tenant/session/auth strength → 2 collect memberships on policy snapshot → 3 capability → 4 applicable data rules → 5 drop false-condition/expired → 6 deny-overrides → 7 allowed set + obligations → 8 constrain request → 9 decision audit. PdpSnapshot, AuthorizationRequest/Resource, PdpError.

fields.cm_summary: Security contract + LocalSecurityClient + internal Rocket controllers (docs/08 §1, docs/09, ADR-008).
fields.cm_detail: SecurityClient trait; LocalSecurityClient calls the PDP in-process (no self-HTTP) with a SnapshotProvider; contract DTOs: ActionDecisionRequest/Response, QueryDecisionRequest/Response, DecisionEffectDto, SecurityContextDto. Internal routes under /internal/security/v1 for mTLS peers.

fields.cm_summary: Schema registry: draft → validate → publish lifecycle + signed bundle loader (docs/12, docs/03 §10). Published revisions immutable (ADR-004).
fields.cm_detail: SchemaDraft (mutable copy → frozen on publish, content hash), SchemaDraftError; validate.rs: ValidationReport/Finding/Severity — aliases/IDs, domain/range/cardinality, inheritance cycles, inverse/symmetric coherence, identity normalizers, Unicode confusables (docs/12 §2); bundle.rs: LoadedBundle → SchemaDraft, referential integrity (domain/range, predicate slots). 19 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Identity normalizers + key material (docs/04 §6-7, §13). Idempotent: normalize(normalize(x)) == normalize(x).
fields.cm_detail: normalize_text (NFC+casefold), normalize_text_search_key, normalize_email, normalize_phone (E.164); NormalizedText/Email/Phone keep raw + canonical + normalizer version.

fields.cm_summary: Query engine: AST + security rewrite + parameterized SQL compiler (docs/07). Pure functions; capability/PDP/execution are caller-side.
fields.cm_detail: ast.rs: QueryAst/WhereExpr/Operator/FieldRef/SelectField/SortKey/RelationDirection/SystemField. rewrite.rs SecurityRewriter: intersect select∩allowed_predicate_ids, drop denied types/predicates, inject mandatory_filters, reject sort/facet on hidden fields, clamp page.size, reject forbidden aggregates. compile.rs: SqlFragment ($N binds — user literals never in SQL text) over core.entity+core.statement.

fields.cm_summary: Connector SDK (docs/14): source-adapter trait, descriptors, instances, observations, rate limiting.
fields.cm_detail: Connector trait (descriptor/validate_credentials/health_check/search/fetch/monitor); ConnectorDescriptor/ConnectorKind (internal|api|file_import|internet|manual)/ConnectorCapabilities/LegalMetadata; ConnectorInstance(+Config: env, base_url, proxy, secrets, rps, concurrency, timeout, retry, cache, legal basis, trust); TrustRank 0-100; SourceObservation/ProvenanceMeta/MappingResult/IdentityResolution; RateLimiter token bucket; CircuitBreaker closed/open/half-open; backoff_delay. 14 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Risk engine: criteria DSL AST + factors + scores + assessment + decision (docs/14 §8-12). AST is data, evaluated by the engine.
fields.cm_detail: Expr/ExprKind 18 node kinds + evaluate() w/ EvaluationContext; Criterion (severity/weight/evidence_selector/valid_interval/tests); Factor (dedup_key, Active/Resolved/Suppressed/Overridden/Expired); WeightedAggregator+ScoreConfig; RiskLevel 0-100; Decision (Approve/Reject/Escalate/Defer/ConditionalApprove, requires_approval High/Critical); Assessment aggregate (Draft/Approved/Superseded, watermark/fingerprint, uncertainty). 31 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Declarative state machine + job lifecycle + tasks + timers + reactions (docs/13).
fields.cm_detail: StateMachineDefinition/State/StateTransition/TransitionGuard/StateMachine.transition (validates, records history, terminal). Job/JobState queued→leased→running→waiting_external|waiting_user→succeeded|partially_succeeded|failed|cancelled + cooperative cancel. Task/TaskStatus/TaskPriority/AssignmentStrategy. Schedule/ScheduleConfig/MisfirePolicy/EscalationTimer/TimerKind. ReactionConfig/ReactionTriggerKind/ActionKind/Reaction (cooldown, dedup, idempotency, compensation, requires_approval). 45 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Staged upload protocol + file scanning + object-storage abstraction (docs/15 §1-3).
fields.cm_detail: StagedUpload (UploadInit/Chunk/Complete/Abort; idempotent chunk re-upload, checksum+size verify, progress). FileScanResult/FileScanStatus/FileSignature/ScanFinding/FileScanner trait (detect_format, scan: size/zip-bomb/formula/macro/links/MIME/AV). ObjectMetadata/StorageClass/ObjectStorage trait (store/retrieve/delete/exists/head; TTL, legal hold). 23 Rust tests.

Dataset/DatasetColumn/DatasetQuery/DatasetStatus/DatasetSnapshot (pinned schema+policy revisions, content hash). ReportDefinition (sections/tables/charts/summaries, locale/tz, allowed formats/audiences, watermark, requires_snapshot, schedule). TemplateDefinition/TemplateVersion/TemplateLocale/FieldFormat. render: TemplateRenderer, RenderContext/Output, escape_formula_injection. 25 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Alternative self-contained security stack (docs/08): ABAC rules, capabilities, classification, local PDP, tamper chain.
fields.cm_detail: abac.rs: DataRule/DataPermission/ResourceSelector/Effect; capability.rs: Capability/CapabilityGroup/CapabilityGroupKind/CapabilityKind; classification.rs: ClassificationLevel/FieldPolicy/FieldPolicyKind/MaskStrategy; pdp.rs: PdpClient/LocalPdpClient/PolicySnapshot/DecisionContext/Decision; audit.rs: AuditEntry/AuditKind/TamperChain. 51 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Audit repository + BLAKE2b tamper-evident hash chain (docs/08 §11,15). Insert-only from app role; separate retention role.
fields.cm_detail: ChainHasher/ChainState: each entry hash includes previous hash; checkpoints persist latest hash; verify recomputes end-to-end. AuditRepository trait + PgAuditRepository (audit.event, audit.chain_checkpoint, audit.retention_policy). 22 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: End-to-end check-flow orchestrator wiring Phase-5 crates (docs/13 §8, docs/14 §4-12).
fields.cm_detail: CheckFlowOrchestrator: check request → connector fetch → mapping/provenance statements → criteria evaluation → factors → score → assessment → decision → workflow instance → tasks → reactions. Ports: Connector/Criterion/Factor/Assessment/Decision/Workflow/Task/Audit. 11 Rust tests.

fields.cm_summary: Cross-crate invariant tests (docs/05 §3, docs/22): security pipeline, schema registry, identity normalizers end-to-end.

rocket_build: mounts /health, /api/v1 (auth, schema admin, entity, audit, skr, files, users + /version + OPTIONS preflight), /internal/security/v1 when security_client present; CorsFairing + AuditFairing; uniform JSON error catchers.
fields.cm_detail: AuditFairing: after mutating /api/v1 calls (and GET /entities/{uuid} views) appends audit.event kind=http_request attributed to the resolved principal. Catchers 400/401/403/404/422/500 → {error:{code,message_key,request_id}} envelope.

fields.cm_summary: Entrypoint: observability init → ApiConfig load → AsyncStdDbExecutor spawn → optional demo seed → in-process SecurityClient (PDP + PG snapshot provider via scoped thread) → rocket_build().launch().
Permissive dev CORS (docs/16 §13): echoes Origin, allows credentials, OPTIONS → 204. Production CORS is on the reverse proxy.
